svg.aria-label: How your data is kept: a person enters something and the card saves it right away, in the place it belongs. Your own choices are saved to your Home Assistant sign-in and follow you. Household things such as lists and schedules are saved once for everyone. A few choices, such as theme and size, stay on that one screen. Every screen and phone then loads the same data back. Safeguards: a failed load never replaces what is shown, updates back up first and migrate old data, and the last 20 versions can be undone, with a copy kept every night.
